summary: The blueprint is broadly plausible for healthy human pancreas but should better resolve immune subtypes, add adipocyte coverage, and tighten the mesothelial marker set.

issues.description: The current modules collapse distinct immune populations into mixed axes: T cells with NK cells, and B cells with plasma cells. These are expected separable immune populations in human pancreas and have distinct canonical markers.
issues.suggested_fix: Add separate T cell, NK cell, B cell, and plasma cell modules/axes, or repurpose the existing broad modules into specific modules and add the missing sibling axes. Use lineage-specific markers such as CD3D/CD3E/TRAC/IL7R for T cells, NKG7/GNLY/KLRD1/GZMB for NK cells, MS4A1/CD79A/CD79B for B cells, and MZB1/JCHAIN/IGKC for plasma cells.

issues.description: There is no adipocyte/lipid-storage axis. For all-cell-type human pancreas with age unspecified, adipocytes and fatty stromal content are plausible tissue-resident or sample-recovered populations and should not be forced into fibroblast or endothelial axes.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an adipocyte module and plain axis using canonical human adipocyte markers such as ADIPOQ, PLIN1, PLIN4, FABP4, LPL, CFD, and PPARG, supported by an appropriate atlas/database resource.

issues.description: The module includes strong mesothelial markers, but KRT19, KRT8, and KRT18 overlap with ductal_epithelial and could make ductal cells score on the mesothelial/capsular axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace some shared ductal keratins with more mesothelial-enriched markers supported by the cited pancreas or Tabula Sapiens resources, while retaining core markers such as MSLN, WT1, UPK3B, and CALB2.

out_of_scope: DOI/resource correctness and database gene-set existence were not checked, per the discriminator scope.
